description: PAID Price: $0.05 USDC (50000 atomic). Real Kraken Futures perpetual funding for multi-collateral perps (PF_XBTUSD, PF_ETHUSD). Returns fundingRateAbsolute, fundingRatePrediction, relativeFundingRate (from historical), openInterest, mark/index, and recentRelativeRates. Public API only — no keys. Prefer symbol; pair is accepted as alias.

pair.description: Alias for symbol (back-compat). e.g. XBTUSD → PF_XBTUSD

symbol.description: Futures symbol or alias: PF_XBTUSD, PF_ETHUSD, XBTUSD, BTC, ETHUSD, ETH. PF_*/PI_*/FI_* used as-is.

name: funding_snapshot

limited.description: Always false — real Kraken Futures data, not a spot-only approximation
